title: Vendor evidence received; remote screening awaits accountable review
friction_point: The fictional vendor supplied the requested validation, release, rollback, software-component and subprocessor exhibits. The clinic must now complete human review, workflow fit and transfer safeguards before activation.
host_citation: This assessment records scenario facts and simulated actions; it does not assert a UAE legal duty.
partner_citation: This assessment records scenario facts and simulated actions; it does not assert a Swiss legal duty.
global_benchmark: No global policy comparison is claimed until a passage-level comparison is reviewed.
remediation_recommendation: Keep activation pending accountable human review. Review the supplied packet, confirm workflow fit and transfer safeguards, then document the activation decision.
finding_method: Deterministic check for a proposed transfer review, a clinic review, an initially incomplete packet, and any later supplied vendor exhibits.
limitations: The conclusion is limited to fictional scenario exhibits and does not establish legal applicability, real-world product quality, or a policy-gap conclusion.
